title: Understanding L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model. Think about how this might affect the uniqueness of the solution.

title: Exploring the OLS Solution
text: The Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) method aims to minimize the sum of squared differences between observed and predicted values. Consider how adding a regularization term might influence the solution's uniqueness.

hintAnswer: L1 regularization can lead to multiple solutions due to its nature of setting some coefficients to zero.
title: Analyzing the Impact of Regularization
text: Which of the following statements is true about L1 regularization?
choices: L1 regularization always leads to a unique solution.
L1 regularization can lead to multiple solutions due to its nature of setting some coefficients to zero.
L1 regularization has no impact on the uniqueness of the solution.

hintAnswer: The system is exactly determined, but regularization can still affect the solution's uniqueness.
title: Considering the Number of Parameters
text: Given that there are $$30$$ parameters and $$30$$ observations, what can you infer about the system of equations?
choices: The system is underdetermined, leading to multiple solutions.
The system is exactly determined, but regularization can still affect the solution's uniqueness.
The system is overdetermined, ensuring a unique solution.
